mapper.sql: r.reservation_id, r.board_game_id, r.room_number, r.status, r.reserved_at, r.fulfilled_at, r.cancelled_at, bg.name AS board_game_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reservation r JOIN board_game bg ON bg.board_game_id = r.board_game_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}
SELECT FROM reservation r JOIN board_game bg ON bg.board_game_id = r.board_game_id WHERE r.board_game_id = #{boardGameId} AND r.status = 'waiting' ORDER BY r.reserved_at, r.reservation_id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE board_game_id = #{boardGameId} AND status = 'waiting' AND reserved_at < (SELECT reserved_at FROM reservation WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId})
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET status = 'cancelled', cancelled_at = NOW() WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'waiting'
UPDATE reservation SET status = 'cancelled', cancelled_at = NOW() WHERE room_number = #{roomNumber} AND status = 'waiting'
